eventMetadata.context_description: Central Weather Administration forecasts and ensemble model guidance place Taipei’s June 1 maximum near the Songshan station in the 28–30 °C range, which underpins the market’s near-even split favoring 29 °C and 28 °C. A seasonal rain front advancing from the north has introduced cloud cover and scattered showers that moderate daytime heating in this subtropical setting, while elevated humidity and light winds limit rapid temperature rises. Historical early-June climatology shows typical highs clustered around 30 °C, yet recent model runs reflect modest cooling relative to the record May heat that preceded the front. Traders weigh the narrow forecast spread against lingering uncertainty in exact timing of any clearing, keeping the top two outcomes tightly matched ahead of final observations.
